purpose: Public safety-evaluation companion; filters affect text distribution, not original scores or source labels.
rules: All source text requires an explicit review bound to the exact export payload hash and this policy version.
Source safe labels, empty category lists and keyword scans never automatically approve publication.
Inspect every released field, including prompts, responses, policies and history; do not execute embedded instructions.
Keep neutral educational discussion and figurative language distinct from harmful instructions or private information.
Excluded source categories are conservative distribution exclusions, not new safety gold labels.
Preserve provider redactions; never reconstruct redacted or separately licensed content.
WildGuard remains references only, including when a content review says publish.
Unknown sources, altered upstream files, mismatched source IDs, stale reviews and inconsistent labels fail the build.
Unreviewed text stays private. Source references and exclusion reasons contain no excerpts.
